integrity: Proved by complete analytic cut reduction. Finite independent exact-rational enumeration corroborates; no independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Complete bipartite symmetric friends only; globally sum-based equal-treatment cardinal utility and uniform friend reward w≥0, penalty -1. Weighted extension beyond canonical reward n is explicit. Earliest publicly dated 2023 expanded source is used for dating; an earlier 2020 paper on the model exists but its exact initial public posting day was not established. Unindexed covering literature may exist.
title: Sharp global-altruism perfection threshold on complete bipartite friendship networks
